name: Looking Further
summary: Theocritus watches eastern Redridge from Elwynn through an enchanted conduit. He seeks the cause of the conflict between Morganth and the Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch Keep, and sends you to place the Glyph of Azora in the nearby watch tower.

sections.title: A Rift in Redridge
sections.body: From his sanctum in Elwynn Forest, Theocritus watches eastern Redridge with scrying magic. As he studies the Tower of Ilgalar, he detects a clash between Morganth, a renegade human warlock, and the Blackrock orcs entrenched in Stonewatch Keep. Both hostile factions should be united against the Kingdom of Stormwind, yet they fight over an unknown prize. Theocritus intervenes before their conflict shifts the balance.

sections.title: The Eye on Stonewatch
sections.body: Theocritus needs a second magical anchor point to pierce Stonewatch Keep’s defenses. So he sends you to climb the intact watch tower beside the ruined fortress. Among the garrison’s clutter, an empty jar discarded by orcish sentries offers a common hiding place. Affix the Glyph of Azora inside, and Theocritus can sift telepathically through minds within Stonewatch to learn what drove Morganth and the Blackrocks apart.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
faq.answer: Theocritus, the Mage of Azora, sends you through the Old Lion Statue in the Redridge Mountains after you complete his prior task.

faq.q: Why is Theocritus spying on Stonewatch Keep?
faq.answer: Theocritus detected active hostility between Morganth, the rogue dark wizard in the Tower of Ilgalar, and the Blackrock orcs occupying Stonewatch Keep. He wants to discover what sparked their conflict.
The empty jar rests atop barrels at the summit of the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep’s main entrance.

faq.q: What does the Glyph of Azora do?
faq.answer: The Glyph of Azora is a magical scrying and divination focus. It lets Theocritus monitor the surrounding area remotely and delve into the minds of the Blackrock orcs inside the keep.

faq.q: What follows after planting the glyph?
faq.answer: Once Theocritus divines the source of the conflict, he sends you to hunt Morganth in the Tower of Ilgalar and retrieve his Pendant of Shadow.
A magical spy rune needs an inconspicuous vessel so guards do not spot or destroy it. The foul-smelling liquor jar, abandoned on the barrels, makes an ideal hiding place.

angles.text: Theocritus uses the Glyph of Azora for long-range scrying, showing how the Mage of Azora watches hostile territories through magic.
Stonewatch Keep remains the Blackrock clan’s primary stronghold in Redridge. Learning about its conflict with Morganth is vital to defending Lakeshire.
